query: when did the cold war end?
answer: The Cold War is usually dated as ending on December 26, 1991, when the Soviet Union was formally dissolved [1][2]. Mikhail Gorbachev resigned as Soviet leader on December 25, and the USSR ceased to exist the next day. That followed the December 8 Belavezha Accords, in which Russia, Ukraine and Belarus declared that the Soviet Union no longer existed [2]. No peace treaty formally ended the Cold War, so some historians put the effective end earlier, with the 1989 revolutions in Eastern Europe and the fall of the Berlin Wall [1].
